services.name: Tandem Skydive
services.desc: You’ll jump from 10,000 feet, securely attached to one of our experienced tandem instructors, and freefall for over 5,000 feet at speeds up to 200 km/h. After that heart-pounding rush, your parachute opens and everything slows down - giving you a peaceful, scenic ride with incredible views of Strathcona Provincial Park, Campbell River, and the Comox Valley. Never skydived before? Perfect. Tandem is made for first-timers. You don’t need any prior experience - your instructor takes care of everything, guiding you through the process from start to finish and making sure it’s as safe and smooth as it is unforgettable. blurb: Guests can experience tandem skydiving with an instructor, take a first jump course to learn solo skydiving basics, join a week-long solo jump camp to earn a solo license, or participate as experienced jumpers with community support and gear rentals. The centre offers scenic views of Strathcona Provincial Park and the Pacific Coast. They provide training, gear, and video packages for jumps.
